class.name: OcgGpTrsf2d
class.brief_description: Defines a non-persistent transformation in 2D space. The following transformations are implemented : - Translation, Rotation, Scale - Symmetry with respect to a point and a line. Complex transformations can be obtained by combining the previous elementary transformations using the method Multiply. The transformations can be represented as follow : where {V1, V2} defines the vectorial part of the transformation and T defines the translation part of the transformation. This transformation never change the nature of the objects.
class.description: ! Defines a non-persistent transformation in 2D space. ! The following transformations are implemented : ! - Translation, Rotation, Scale ! - Symmetry with respect to a point and a line. ! Complex transformations can be obtained by combining the ! previous elementary transformations using the method Multiply. ! The transformations can be represented as follow : ! @code ! V1 V2 T XY XY ! | a11 a12 a13 | | x | | x'| ! | a21 a22 a23 | | y | | y'| ! | 0 0 1 | | 1 | | 1 | ! @endcode ! where {V1, V2} defines the vectorial part of the transformation ! and T defines the translation part of the transformation. ! This transformation never change the nature of the objects.

method.name: default
method.description: Returns identity transformation.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a 2d transformation in the XY plane from a 3d transformation .

method.name: SetMirror_1
method.description: Changes the transformation into a symmetrical transformation. theP is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: SetMirror_2
method.description: Changes the transformation into a symmetrical transformation. theA is the center of the axial symmetry.

method.name: SetRotation
method.description: Changes the transformation into a rotation. theP is the rotation's center and theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radian.

method.name: SetScale
method.description: Changes the transformation into a scale. theP is the center of the scale and theS is the scaling value.

method.name: SetTransformation_2
method.description: Changes a transformation allowing passage from the coordinate system "theFromSystem1" to the coordinate system "theToSystem2".

method.name: SetTransformation_1
method.description: Changes the transformation allowing passage from the basic coordinate system {P(0.,0.,0.), VX (1.,0.,0.), VY (0.,1.,0.)} to the local coordinate system defined with the Ax2d theToSystem.

method.name: SetTranslation_1
method.description: Changes the transformation into a translation. theV is the vector of the translation.

method.name: SetTranslation_2
method.description: Makes the transformation into a translation from the point theP1 to the point theP2.

method.name: SetTranslationPart
method.description: Replaces the translation vector with theV.

method.name: SetScaleFactor
method.description: Modifies the scale factor.

method.name: Form
method.description: Returns the nature of the transformation. It can be an identity transformation, a rotation, a translation, a mirror (relative to a point or an axis), a scaling transformation, or a compound transformation.

method.name: ScaleFactor
method.description: Returns the scale factor.

method.name: TranslationPart
method.description: Returns the translation part of the transformation's matrix

method.name: VectorialPart
method.description: Returns the vectorial part of the transformation. It is a 2*2 matrix which includes the scale factor.

method.name: HVectorialPart
method.description: Returns the homogeneous vectorial part of the transformation. It is a 2*2 matrix which doesn't include the scale factor. The coefficients of this matrix must be multiplied by the scale factor to obtain the coefficients of the transformation.

method.name: RotationPart
method.description: Returns the angle corresponding to the rotational component of the transformation matrix (operation opposite to SetRotation()).

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the coefficients of the transformation's matrix. It is a 2 rows * 3 columns matrix. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 2 or theCol < 1 or theCol > 3

method.name: Inverted
method.description: Computes the reverse transformation. Raises an exception if the matrix of the transformation is not inversible, it means that the scale factor is lower or equal to Resolution from package gp.

method.name: Multiply
method.description: Computes the transformation composed from <me> and theT. <me> = <me> * theT

method.name: PreMultiply
method.description: Computes the transformation composed from <me> and theT. <me> = theT * <me>

method.name: Powered
method.description: Computes the following composition of transformations <me> * <me> * .......* <me>, theN time. if theN = 0 <me> = Identity if theN < 0 <me> = <me>.Inverse() *...........* <me>.Inverse().

method.name: SetValues
method.description: Sets the coefficients of the transformation. The transformation of the point x,y is the point x',y' with : The method Value(i,j) will return aij. Raises ConstructionError if the determinant of the aij is null. If the matrix as not a uniform scale it will be orthogonalized before future using.
